description: This Java class 'GatewayResponse' models the response from the eWay payment gateway, parsing an XML response to populate response fields such as transaction number, reference, amount, status, and error details. It provides getter methods for these fields and constructs itself by parsing an InputStream containing the XML response.

classes.name: GatewayResponse
classes.description: Represents and parses the eWay payment gateway's XML response, providing access to transaction details, status, and errors.

methods.name: GateWayResponse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response object by parsing the provided XML InputStream, extracting transaction details, status, and errors.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response object with all parsed fields in XML format.
